problem.story.part1: Onye Naịjirịa na-emepụta ihe malitere ngwa ahụike.
problem.story.part2: Ndị ọrụ hụrụ ya n'anya — 5,000 debanyere aha n'izu mbụ. Izu abụọ ka e mesịrị, NDPC zigara ọkwa mmanye.
problem.fine.part2: — ma ọ bụ 2% nke ego ha nwetara n'afọ, nke ọ bụla ka ukwuu. Enweghị amụma nzuzo. Enweghị usoro nkwenye. Enweghị nyocha data.
problem.solution: RegTrack na-egbochi nke a. N'ime nkeji, ọ bụghị ọnwa.

footer.tagline: Ịgakọta ihe ọhụrụ Naịjirịa na usoro iwu. Nrubeisi NDP Act & GAID 2025 nke AI kwadoro maka ndị na-ewu ọdịnihu Afrịka.
footer.whyBuilt.title: Ihe Mere Anyị Ji Wuo Nke a Maka Naịjirịa
footer.whyBuilt.description: Ndị Naịjirịa na-emepụta ihe wuru ya na Abuja, maka usoro iwu Naịjirịa. Anyị kwenyere na onye ọ bụla na-amalite azụmahịa na Naịjirịa kwesịrị ịmalite na ntụkwasị obi — n'ịmara na omume data ha na-echekwa ma ndị ọrụ ha ma azụmahịa ha. RegTrack dị n'ihi na nrubeisi ekwesịghị ịbụ ihe mgbochi nye ihe ọhụrụ na gburugburu teknụzụ kacha ukwuu n'Africa. Nke NDP Act 2023, Usoro Mmejuputa NDPR, na GAID 2025 kwadoro.
